text_block_list.text:
One day in the early afternoon. Grass 
Wonder had some kind of troubled look on 
her face...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm. Eating any more than this would 
really be...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I was just troubled over how 
big of a lunch to get~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm ashamed to say it, but... I'm 
already completely full...
choice_data_list: Did you have a snack or something?
Did you have a snack or something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Up until just a moment ago, I was 
holding an outdoor tea ceremony with my 
classmates, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The tea I whisked with everyone was so 
delicious that I ended up eating too many 
tea sweets without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It was a lot of fun~. Spe-chan had sweets 
clutched in both hands the whole time... 
Hehe♪"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, what should we do? Even if 
she only has herself to blame for it...

Grass Wonder looks conflicted. Eating any 
more might cause her to gain weight, but—
choice_data_list:
They also say "overeating cuts life 
short."

They also say "you can't fight on an empty 
stomach."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... that is true. I shall exercise 
moderation for today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But the open-air tea ceremony was 
really fun~ Next time, why don't you join 
us, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Next time I hold it, I'll be sure to go 
easy on the sweets♪

Grass Wonder was in high spirits after 
preparing tea with her friend.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... it is true that a half-hearted 
meal will drain one's energy right away~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Proper nutrition is also a part of 
training. Though it might be a bit too 
much to eat, I shall make sure to have a 
proper meal♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Since we have the chance, let's plan 
a menu that goes well with the leftover 
tea—

After that, Grass Wonder ate plenty of 
food before tackling her training.
